name: SMA Crossover Strategy — SPY
description: 50/200 SMA crossover strategy on SPY. Long when 50 SMA crosses above 200 SMA, short when it crosses below. Risk-based position sizing: 1% of account risked per trade with a 2x ATR(14) stop distance.
source:
# 50/200 SMA Crossover Strategy — SPY
# Long when 50 SMA crosses above 200 SMA, short when it crosses below
# Risk-based sizing: 1% of account per trade, stop = 2× ATR(14)

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 50-day (fast) and 200-day (slow) SMA
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# ATR(14) for risk-based stop distance
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)
stop_dist = atr_val * 2

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Golden cross (50 crosses above 200) → long
# Death cross (50 crosses below 200) → short
golden_cross = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)
death_cross = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# Hold state between crossover events
long_state = hold_until()(enter=golden_cross, exit=death_cross)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=death_cross, exit=golden_cross)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long and short zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# Risk-based sizing: risk 1% of account per trade, stop at 2× ATR(14)
# risk_unit bundles position sizing + stop loss atomically
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# Trailing stop at 3× ATR for profit protection on winning trades
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 3)
